summary: Runtime security closure: mandatory admission, canonical artifact closure (symlinks/special files/unlisted files refused), immutable snapshots, signed production activation receipts with load-measured artifact digests, strict versioned schemas, revocation freshness, replay nonces.

repairs.title: Make runtime admission mandatory in every supported model-loading path
repairs.behavior: TrustedRuntimeLauncher verifies the full signed chain, measures artifacts physically, stages an immutable snapshot, loads the backend from the snapshot only, and emits a signed production receipt after a successful load. PeftServingBackend refuses anything but an ApprovedSnapshot; the CUDA loader refuses adapter_path in serving mode.

repairs.title: Canonical artifact closure: refuse symlinks/special files, bind the complete authorized listing
repairs.behavior: close_tree() refuses symbolic links and unsupported special files (never skips them), rejects path traversal, and returns (path, size, sha256) entries. verify_entries() fails on missing, unexpected, resized, or modified files. Digest compatibility with v16.4.0 semantics is preserved for clean trees; trees that previously hashed incompletely are refused.

repairs.title: Signed production activation receipts with load-measured artifacts
repairs.behavior: Receipt schema v2 binds candidate_digest, qualification/promotion/manifest digests, loaded_artifact_digests measured at load, backend_id, activation_nonce, activated_at, signer_key_id and signature. check_activation_receipt requires a signature by default and require_production=True refuses admission-only receipts. write_activation_receipt refuses unsigned receipts; the admission CLI has no unsigned mode.

repairs.title: Strict versioned schemas, mandatory protocol identity, revocation freshness
repairs.behavior: One validator per authority-bearing artifact; unknown versions, absent/malformed digests, unsupported backends, and unsafe listing paths are refused. Admission requires the plan's experiment_protocol_digest to equal the manifest's protocol_digest and the qualification's evaluation_bundle_digest to equal the decision's. promote.py refuses to sign decisions whose evaluation or protocol binding is missing.

repairs.title: Immutable snapshots close the time-of-check/time-of-use window
repairs.behavior: Single-pass copy-and-verify stages exactly the bytes that were hashed; the staged digest must equal the authorized digest; the tree is frozen read-only and re-measured immediately before load. ApprovedSnapshot is constructible only by stage_snapshot.

features.title: v2 runtime manifest with explicit authorized file listing
features.note: mini-agi-v16.5-peft-runtime-manifest-v2 binds adapter_files; serving requires v2 (the launcher refuses aggregate-digest-only manifests).

features.title: RevocationList with generation time and freshness enforcement
features.note: The launcher requires a revocation list (default max age 7 days); a stale list refuses instead of being treated as empty.

features.title: Replay nonces recorded in an append-only journal
features.note: Each production receipt carries a fresh 128-bit nonce; the journal makes reuse detectable.

features.title: Trusted launch CLI and launcher rollback lineage
features.note: scripts/trusted_launch.py --backend-factory module:callable; rollback re-admits a previously receipted release and records rollback_of in the receipt.

adversarial_acceptance: adding a symlink to an approved adapter prevents activation
changing one byte of an approved adapter prevents activation
an unsigned or admission-only receipt cannot authorize serving
an unknown schema version, absent digest, or unsupported backend is refused
a stale revocation list refuses; a revoked decision replay refuses
no receipt is written when admission, staging, or the backend load fails
